capabilities: Open standard for runtime job/dataset lineage
decision: Adopt run and dataset lineage events
limitation: Add causal estimands and assumptions as explicit custom facets
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Job/run/dataset identifiers and versioned event/facet payloads.
scientific_qualification.output: Lineage events and an extensible provenance graph.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Emitted events are complete enough for replay and correspond to actual immutable data/model versions.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Define separate causal-analysis facets for target, observation clock, graph/model, split plan and estimator. A successful job event does not certify identification or inference.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Replay reordered/duplicate events, correlate one analysis to exact dataset/model artifacts, and require unknown facet versions to remain visible.

evidence.finding: Run/job/dataset model, runtime events and custom facets.
